source.title: Mika Häkkinen — Formula 1 Hall of Fame
source.author: Gerald Donaldson (verify page byline)
source.locator: See precise paragraph or heading locator on each linked claim; unlinked claims remain pending.
source.verification_note: Formula 1 Hall of Fame text inspected on 2026-10-24; unlinked claims still require direct corroboration; no human EN/UK review or independent publisher corroboration.

claims.en: Häkkinen won the 1998 and 1999 Formula 1 Drivers' World Championships with McLaren.
claims.uk: Гаккінен виграв чемпіонати світу Формули-1 серед пілотів 1998 та 1999 років із McLaren.

evidence.locator: Hall of Fame heading '1998, 1999'; paragraphs on 1998 and 1999 titles with McLaren.

claims.en: Häkkinen began his Formula 1 racing career with Lotus.
claims.uk: Гаккінен розпочав гоночну кар’єру у Формулі-1 з Lotus.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'The new Flying Finn won three Scandinavian': promoted to F1 by Team Lotus.

claims.en: Häkkinen survived a serious accident during practice for the 1995 Australian Grand Prix in Adelaide.
claims.uk: Гаккінен пережив важку аварію під час практики Гран-прі Австралії 1995 року в Аделаїді.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'The worst accident of his career': 1995 Adelaide practice crash.

claims.en: Häkkinen won his first Formula 1 Grand Prix at the 1997 European Grand Prix.
claims.uk: Гаккінен здобув свою першу перемогу у Формулі-1 на Гран-прі Європи 1997 року.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'If the Flying Finn was still fast': first F1 victory at Jerez 1997 European GP.

gaps: Record precise per-claim source locators and independent corroboration.
Human review of both languages and exact revision required before publication.
